<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex040012026-09-0105-16-12" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3921">tho</rs> na re bsaM gtan dang po yan cad kyi
            gzugs te dngos su thogs °ugs dang bcas par mi 'dug kyang | thogs bcas gyi skyed rung gi
            rigs yin pas ma khyab pa myed de || de dang mtshan nyid mtshungs pa'i 'dod pa'i bsaMs
            kyi gzugs de buM pa lasogs pa la thogs pas so zhes zer te | thogs bcas gyi rigs yin la de'i mtshan nyid gyis ma khyab pa nyid gyis skyon <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="108a6"/> can du grub ste | dper na ba lang gi mtshan nyid du nog dang lkog shal khra bor bkod pa'i tshe | nag sgur
            de ba lang gyi rigs ni yin la | khra bo'i nog dang lkog shal med pas skyon can yin pa <expan>bzhin no</expan> || 
            
            des na bsaM gtan dang po las pa'i gtugs deg yongs su sbyar ba ma byas pa'i rtsogs
            bcas yin kyang | rigs dang rgyal po'i thogs bcas yin pas sogs dang bcas pas gzugs can
            bcu' <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="108a7"/> zhes bshad pa dang myi 'gal lo zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3864">byang chub skyabs</rs> gsung ngo ||</seg></TEI>
